verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review platform with a fix-generation coding agent, so asking whether a cloud agent can build, test, and demo a feature is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows targeted fixes for review findings pushed to an existing PR branch. Nothing documents an agent that builds a whole feature, runs tests, or produces a demo for review.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
